description: Get one event by URI (the `uri` from search_events, e.g. "eng-1234567"). Returns its summary info by default; set include_articles=true to instead list the articles covering it (paginated, default 5 per page, body truncated to body_len). Cost: 5 tokens (info view) or 1 (articles view), measured live.

include_articles.description: Return the event’s articles instead of its info (default false).

name: get_event
